note: All names, figures and products are fictional and illustrative.

boundary_labels.extended_illustrative: Same state, extended: illustrative. Not built.

mandatory_limitations.registration_verified: Verified in the field. Registry not independently queried.
mandatory_limitations.generic_verified: Sighted by field agent. Issuing body not contacted.
mandatory_limitations.generic_supported: Supplied by the cooperative. Not independently checked.

invariants: I1 No self-verification: the user who supplied evidence can never mark it Verified.
I2 Supersede, never overwrite: every change appends to evidence history.
I3 Every state shows its basis (evidence, who, when, limitation).
I4 Readiness is computed from state plus a destination's requirements, never typed in.
I5 Symphony does not decide outcomes. Outcomes belong to the lender. Findings belong to the verifier.
I6 No Arrangement object exists before a financing relationship; none is built in this prototype.
I7 Every screen carries a boundary label.
I8 Findings, disputes and reliance are records. They never change evidence items.
